title: Handoff authoring preflight and cold-start completeness
summary: Prevent late structural rejection and enforce concrete cold-agent resume context before persisting handoffs.
description: `packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts`, `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`, `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, and the canonical planner skill currently validate an 18-category handoff audit but can still accept generic behavioral prose that omits concrete runtime wiring, files, symbols, commands, operator actions, and exact resume steps. `handoff_prepare` also does not expose the exact required canonical headings and draft scaffold early enough, so an agent can spend substantial tokens drafting a handoff and only then receive a missing-sections rejection. Add a pre-authoring contract that returns the exact required section scaffold and bounded budget before drafting; require a structured cold-start evidence inventory for files, symbols, commands/tools, runtime wiring, user-visible behavior, operator actions, risks, partial work, and ordered next steps; deterministically verify every declared inventory item is represented in the inline handoff or a validated linked `.planner/docs/` supporting document; preserve the 24,000-character inline ceiling, legacy readability, atomic write/read-back/hash guarantees, and Pi/MCP parity. Regression coverage must reproduce the reported omission of `drain_pending_drops`, `install_drop_sink`, `pending_drops`, `pane_drop_row`, `DragItemRegistry`, `column_drop`, `accept_drop`, `showcase`, `Dropped`, `startup.rs`, `drag_identity`, `paint_drag_feedback`, `resolve_at_for`, and `DropHit`, ensuring a cold agent receives concrete wiring context without a second full rewrite.

tasks.title: Make handoff preparation scaffold-first and cold-agent complete
tasks.description:
`packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts`, `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`, Pi/MCP handoff prepare/write handlers in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts` and `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, and `packages/plan-core/planner-skill.md` currently expose a late-failing structural contract and an audit that can be satisfied with generic prose. Implement a single-pass authoring workflow: handoff_prepare must return the exact required canonical headings, a ready-to-fill bounded template, required audit categories, existing handoff/task evidence, and the 24,000-character budget before prose generation. Extend handoff_write with a versioned structured cold-start inventory covering exact files, symbols, commands/tools, runtime wiring, user-visible behavior, operator actions, blockers/risks, partial/remaining work, and ordered resume steps; validate that every inventory item appears in the inline body or a hash-validated committed `.planner/docs/` supporting document before mutation. Return precise typed preflight diagnostics rather than a generic post-generation missing-sections error, preserve legacy handoff reads, reconciliation, atomic hash verification, rollback, bounded transport, and Web UI full-content behavior. Add regressions using the reported missing symbols `drain_pending_drops`, `install_drop_sink`, `pending_drops`, `pane_drop_row`, `DragItemRegistry`, `column_drop`, `accept_drop`, `showcase`, `Dropped`, `startup.rs`, `drag_identity`, `paint_drag_feedback`, `resolve_at_for`, and `DropHit`, proving incomplete wiring cannot be certified and a complete prepared template persists once without rewrite.

---
**Completion summary:**
Completed scaffold-first, cold-agent-complete handoff authoring. `packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts` now returns a 16-section canonical draft scaffold before prose, requires five substantive source reviews (including peer-agent/network output), and validates a 14-category cold-start inventory whose every category contains a concrete item represented verbatim inline or in a hash-validated `.planner/docs/` supporting document. The contract captures exact files/symbols/commands, working-tree ownership and commit authorization, negative state, runtime wiring, preservation constraints, verification evidence, sibling/related planned work, user-visible behavior, operator actions, risks, remaining work, and ordered resume steps. Pi and MCP prepare/write schemas, agent guidance, planner rules, persisted audit metadata, fixtures, and public-surface inventory were synchronized. Existing bounded transport, 24,000-character inline ceiling, legacy reads, atomic read-back/hash verification, exact rollback, and Web UI full-content behavior remain preserved. Verified with `pnpm check`, targeted core/MCP/Pi handoff suites (122/122 test assertions across the focused commands, with package-only Pi coverage below its standalone baseline but zero test failures), `pnpm plugins:sync`, `pnpm plugins:check`, `git diff --check`, and `pnpm test:coverage`: 536/536 Node tests, 88/88 Web UI tests, final coverage 86.76% lines, 74.34% branches, 81.76% functions. No commit or push was performed.
